title: S3 Production Environment & CDE Governance
purpose: Govern the internal production ecosystem, CDE platform authority, ISO 19650 information-state transitions, collaboration boundaries, output handling, and procedural interfaces to S2, S5, S7, S8, and the CDE implementation branch.

requirements.statement: ACC Docs shall serve as the primary governed internal cloud environment for TIVERIT project collaboration and information-container management, subject to project contractual precedence.

Authoring tools are authoritative only within their declared scope; governed reliance begins only when information is placed in the appropriate governed platform/container and satisfies the decision and information-status conditions applicable to its declared use.
Software versions are project-governed through the BEP; enterprise standards govern tool roles and authority boundaries rather than fixed releases.

Monitoring tools, scripts, automation, platform permissions, or CDE workflow actions do not independently create authority; where an ISO 19650 decision is required for a state transition, the applicable decision shall be made by the party or function assigned by the governing appointment and project information-management arrangements.

Informal collaboration, chat, markup, visibility, or CDE location shall not substitute for the review, approval, authorization, or acceptance activity required for an applicable ISO 19650 information-state transition.
Working outputs and formally issued deliverables shall remain distinct; formal exchange shall bind to S2 information requirements, S7 delivery-process semantics, and permitted-use constraints.

S1 governs organizational authority, S2 governs information requirements, S7 governs the ISO 19650 information-model delivery sequence and supplementary TIVERIT exchange/handover controls, and CDE procedural execution is delegated to governed implementation workflows.
S3 governs the internal production ecosystem and shall not assert authority over external consultant systems, client environments, or contractual liabilities beyond project-defined interfaces.

The existence, availability, visual completeness, CDE location, or technical publication action of a production output shall not substitute for the ISO 19650 decision process associated with the applicable state transition.
Production outputs intended for governed use shall have an explicitly declared information state and status appropriate to their purpose; apparent detail shall not substitute for that declaration.
The communication channel used for collaboration shall not alter the governance status, authority, decision state, or permitted use of the information communicated.

Uploading, downloading, synchronizing, linking, attaching, or otherwise moving information within or between production systems shall not substitute for the governed review and decision required for transition between ISO 19650 CDE states.

For ISO 19650-governed information management, the CDE lifecycle shall distinguish Work in Progress, Shared, Published, and Archived states, with state transitions controlled by the applicable review and decision activities.

Transition from Work in Progress to Shared shall follow the applicable review and approval-for-sharing activity. TIVERIT identifies this ISO 19650 exchange decision as Decision A for implementation and conformance mapping.

Information in Shared shall be available only for the permitted shared-state purposes and shall proceed through the applicable information-model review, authorization, submission, and acceptance activities before transition to Published where ISO 19650-2 delivery provisions apply.

Transition from Shared to Published shall occur only after the applicable authorization and acceptance process has been completed. TIVERIT identifies this ISO 19650 exchange decision as Decision B for implementation and conformance mapping; where the process is separated, authorization by the lead appointed party precedes acceptance by the appointing party in accordance with the applicable ISO 19650-2 delivery sequence.

A decision-bearing CDE transition shall preserve traceability to the applicable review, decision outcome, responsible ISO 19650 party or project-mapped function, affected information scope, status/permitted use, and supporting evidence. The resulting CDE state records the completed transition but shall not replace that evidence.

Archived information shall preserve the historical record of information-container states, revisions, status and decision evidence required by the applicable project, contractual, regulatory and retention requirements; movement to Archived is a record-preservation transition and shall not be used as a substitute for acceptance or handover decisions.

implementation_gaps: CDE implementation artifacts shall be checked to ensure Work in Progress to Shared implements Decision A approval-for-sharing semantics and Shared to Published implements Decision B authorization/acceptance semantics without substituting platform permissions for the required ISO 19650 party decisions.
Conformance coverage shall verify traceability between decision-bearing CDE transitions and the applicable review/decision evidence, information status, permitted use and responsible party.
governance_notes: For ISO 19650-governed exchanges, information state and decision are coupled through the defined transition process: Decision A governs Work in Progress to Shared and Decision B governs Shared to Published. The CDE state records the outcome of that process but is not a substitute for its audit evidence.

Decision A and Decision B are used as implementation labels from ISO 19650-4 exchange-process semantics. ISO 19650-2 provides the underlying delivery activities, including task-team approval for sharing and the lead-appointed-party authorization / appointing-party acceptance sequence.
Project-specific status codes, transition permissions, review workflows and platform configuration remain project/CDE declarations where ISO 19650 does not prescribe the implementation mechanism.
ISO source evidence informs this curator reconciliation through the External Standards Gateway; applicability and contractual precedence remain governed by project instruments.

provenance.migration_note: Canonical S3 parent assembled from source production-environment doctrine. ISO-IMP-005 re-audit aligns the CDE lifecycle to ISO 19650: Work in Progress to Shared is controlled by approval for sharing (Decision A mapping), and Shared to Published by the applicable authorization and acceptance process (Decision B mapping). Archived remains the historical record state.
